answer.summary: The API types check fails deterministically because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the PR's API produces a diff adding @minItems 1 to FindingRetestInput.finding_ids, and the job exits 1 asking for the types to be regenerated. Re-running will fail the same way; fix by running yarn generate-types-from-api and committing the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
